name: mako
description: Mako, the AI-native SQL client: PNPM workspace root (api, app, docs, packages).

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter app run dev" "pnpm --filter api run dev" "pnpm dlx inngest-cli@1.53.0 dev" "./scripts/sandbox-tunnel.sh"
scripts.build: pnpm run lint:all && pnpm run build:ci
scripts.build:ci: pnpm --filter @mako/schemas run build && pnpm --filter @mako/agent-tools run build && pnpm run app:build && pnpm run api:build && node scripts/check-connector-agnosticism.js
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose down && docker compose build && docker compose up -d
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run openapi:generate && pnpm --filter docs run build
scripts.openapi:sync: pnpm run openapi:generate && pnpm run api-types:generate
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run app:lint && pnpm run api:lint && node scripts/check-connector-agnosticism.js
scripts.lint:fix:all: pnpm run app:lint:fix && pnpm run api:lint:fix && node scripts/check-connector-agnosticism.js
scripts.connectors:install: npm ci --prefix connectors/stripe --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/close --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/posthog --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/pandadoc --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/claap --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/wise --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/calendly --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/graphql --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix connectors/bigquery --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts
scripts.connectors:typecheck: tsc -p connectors/stripe/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/close/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/posthog/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/pandadoc/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/claap/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/wise/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/calendly/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/graphql/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/bigquery/tsconfig.json
scripts.connectors:conformance: node connectors/stripe/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/close/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/posthog/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/pandadoc/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/claap/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/wise/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/calendly/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/graphql/fixtures/conformance.mjs && node connectors/bigquery/fixtures/conformance.mjs
scripts.connectors:parity: pnpm --filter api exec tsx ../connectors/stripe/fixtures/parity.mjs && pnpm --filter api exec tsx ../connectors/close/fixtures/parity.mjs && pnpm --filter api exec tsx ../connectors/posthog/fixtures/parity.mjs && pnpm --filter api exec tsx ../connectors/claap/fixtures/parity.mjs && pnpm --filter api exec tsx ../connectors/calendly/fixtures/parity.mjs

{api/src/routes/**/*.ts,api/src/openapi/: bash -c 'pnpm run openapi:sync && git add docs/src/openapi/mako-api.json app/src/api/schema.d.ts'
